https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x full suite with ignored tests

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A gossip run using only IHAVE passes the test but is reported as an oracle failure by the script
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The Rust oracle counts eager plus IHAVE bytes while derive-legacy-bus-attempts.py counts eager bytes only, so they disagree.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Coverage Gate fails with EISDIR because KvStoreSync applies a delta after retire()
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: An unbiased tokio select! lets the listener process a delta after the store is retired, so it can merge and persist into a path that is being torn down.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x KV stores being retired while deltas arrive

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Reopening a KV store can race the retired sync's in-flight persist on the same snapshot path
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The retired sync may still be writing its snapshot when the store is reopened; review rated it bounded and self-healing.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x KV store retire then quick reopen

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: revoke_binding always fails for the daemon's own agent
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Self-issued certs are journaled with cert_b64: None and the discovery cache never contains ourselves, so the lookup fails with 'no certificate known for the agent'.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x 0.45.0, revoking the local agent's binding

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: On Leaf nodes, DM-inbox and join messages never reach some directly connected peers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: ordered_leaf_peers sorts by PeerId bytes and truncates to leaf_max_eager_degree (default 2); saorsa-gossip then drops the others entirely, so they get neither eager pushes nor IHAVE.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x Leaf nodes with more connected peers than the eager degree

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Apps cannot get a detached signature that still verifies after the data is stored
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Transport-layer signatures on gossip frames do not survive storage, so records like audit logs need a detached ML-DSA-65 signature over arbitrary bytes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: The receive pump drops Critical IHAVE frames when the PubSub queue is over 90% full
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: All control frames are shed by kind before priority checks, so even DM-topic (x0x/dm/v1/*) lazy repair messages can be lost under saturation.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A late joiner never gets a private KV store's history when only a plain member is online
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: With the owner and admin offline, the only holder was a plain member and the joiner did not receive the value within 120 s on testnet.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x private KV, late joiner, owner and admin offline

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: public_pubsub_key_cache_full_ref_restart_recovery sometimes receives the pre-restart payload
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: About 4 in 25 runs, tests/gossip_key_cache_transport.rs:185 sees initial-0 where it expects after-restart-0.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x gossip key-cache transport CI test

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A second owner device creates a duplicate Home and /home/seat invites into the wrong one
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: After getting the copied owner key and restarting, the device creates its own Home before the canonical Home pointer syncs, ends up in two Homes, and POST /home/seat returns 200 for the duplicate.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x Home with multiple owner devices

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: warn! and error! logs print raw peer identifiers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: After switching the fleet to RUST_LOG=warn to cut log volume, identifiers in warning and error logs still need to be salted hashes for privacy.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Per-peer events are logged at info! level, exposing peer activity
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Moving them to trace! adds privacy defence in depth beyond hashed identifiers.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A TreeKEM joiner throws away a Welcome it already received when its fetch ACK times out
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: When the FetchRequest delivery ACK times out (24 s; the gossip inbox runs 19-24 s under load), cleanup and early return happen before reading the result channel.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x TreeKEM group join under load

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Owner-sync sessions between mutually enrolled devices fail with 'stream reset by peer 0xA17C0244'
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Every session failed both ways and initiator-side errors are logged only at debug in src/owner_sync.rs, hiding the cause.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x owner devices that enrolled each other

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: TreeKEM catch-up can adopt commits from a forking responder without checking the owner attestation
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: handle_treekem_catchup_response only checks the responder is a member and applies intervening commits before checking they lead to the pending owner-attested head.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: SelfKeyed quota silently evicts the writer's keys instead of refusing the 65th put
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: With MAX_SELFKEYED_KEYS_PER_AGENT = 64 the store keeps the lowest 64 keys and drops the rest, yet the put returns success.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x 0.45.0 SelfKeyed KV stores, over 64 keys per agent

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A new member of an encrypted group only gets store values via slow repair (55-120 s or more)
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The live publish does not reach the joiner, it relies on repair; there are silent drop paths and a misleading checkpoint-subsumed WARN.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x encrypted (GSS) group stores, freshly joined member

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: After daemon restarts, pubsub eager fan-out skips every candidate and announcements arrive 22-60 s late
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Logs showed candidates=6 claim_skipped=6 attempted=0: all forwarding peers were cooling, over control budget, or not connected.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A Home owner device creates a duplicate Home after an empty sync with a peer that has not published its Home pointer
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The rank-0 creator is released by any successful owner-sync session, even one with a peer that has a Home but has not yet published its pointer.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x Home provisioning with multiple owner devices

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: GET /groups/:id/delegations exposes member identities and fork_quarantine to non-members
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: When a group is read_open, a non-member session bearer gets from_agent/to_agent and the quarantine annotation, though GET /groups/:id already refuses them.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x read_open groups, non-member session tokens

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Home membership events are dropped and role updates silently rejected after join events got bigger
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Joins now carry an AgentCertificate (~51.5 KB, over the 49,152-byte DM limit), so they become staged control blobs; only 4 per peer are allowed and they free only on a 10 min TTL.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x Home joins with certificate-carrying events

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: 409 error bodies on group send/encrypt/decrypt/reseal leak fork_quarantine to non-members
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The annotation is returned before any membership or write check, undoing the earlier redaction.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x named groups API, non-member session bearers

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A full relay channel drops a predecessor offer but still ACKs it, and prefix routing misroutes ordinary DMs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Two review findings on the raw typed DM dispatch change already merged into the release candidate.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A ShareGrant grantee that missed the delivery has no way to fetch it again
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Follow-up from ADR-0070: grants delivered while the grantee was unreachable are lost.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x ShareGrant delivery to offline grantees

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: scripts/install.py rejects every real release because it pins the wrong GPG fingerprint
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The pinned release-signing fingerprint 9D1F3C64B5D3C2F6B4A2E6D8A5C7F8E9D0B1A2C3 was a placeholder.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A daemon joining a KvStore late does not receive keys written before it joined
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: The joining daemon does not bootstrap the existing store state through the REST API.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: The port forwarder never sends FIN on QUIC streams, so TCP half-close hangs and stream tails are lost
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Without finishing the stream, the end of the data is lost when the stream is reset.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: A frame sealed under an old epoch is seen after leave, rekey and restart in encrypted KV
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: tests/encrypted_kv_transport.rs panicked with 'relevant transport frame rejected: old epoch'; unclear if flake or a post-leave confidentiality bug.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.applies_when: x0x encrypted KV after member leave, rekey and restart

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: KV put reports success even when its publish times out or is refused
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: Callers cannot tell the write never propagated to peers.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Joiner's Welcome-blob fetch fails with ReaderExit and the staged Welcome is silently dropped
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: With multi-path MemberAdded delivery, the FetchRequest uses the same failing direct-DM channel, and the apply path drops the Welcome on failure.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.problem: Callers holding a ShareGrant with the Call cap are not admitted at the inbound call gate
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/issue.detail: A caller failing only on trust should be admitted with a live, unrevoked, unexpired Call grant, while revocation, expiry, ACL and dm_verified checks still run in order.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Prune expired ShareGrant outbox entries on disk and include due entries in the reconnect nudge
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both fixes are in src/share_grant/outbox.rs, so stale entries go away and due ones are sent promptly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Use send_replace for the DM capability upgrade so the value is kept with no receivers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: send_replace stores the new value even before anyone subscribes, so the advert shows gossip-ready. The batch also adds user-id inspect, sign domain separation and warn-default logging.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make seat events carry owner-certified roster certificates
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The joiner's stub only had roster digests; carrying the certificates lets the admin seal without fetching from the offline creator.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply opt-level = 3 only to the signing test profile, not every x0x test target
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The setting made CI compile all x0x tests with full optimisation, raising median CI time from about 28 to 70 minutes; scoping it keeps the slow test fast without the cost.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Admit and dial enrolled owner machines based on verified enrollment, not the discovery cache
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Enrollment is durable and verified, so it works right after restart when the cache is still empty.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Version the KV snapshot magic so v0.46 can load snapshots written by v0.45
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A new field, last_history_endorser, was placed before seq_counter, so old snapshots failed with UnexpectedEof and every store was skipped; a versioned header reads each layout correctly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Encode the KV direct-delivery payload with bincode instead of serde_json
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The OR-Set's HashSet<UniqueTag> and the HashMap<PeerId, u64> vector clock cannot be JSON maps; bincode handles them.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Isolate the upgrade daemon-discovery tests from any running local x0xd.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Two tests in src/cli/commands/upgrade.rs read real machine state, so they failed wherever an x0xd daemon was or had been running.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make PeerStream::agent return Option instead of panicking
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A recent change could panic in production when the agent was unknown; returning Option makes callers handle that case.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-check machine revocation in the SyncV1 acceptor
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A machine revoked while a sync was being set up could slip through a race; checking again at accept time closes it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Recover trimmed roster certificates after a MemberAdded event using the group certificate protocol
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A joiner seated by a trimmed MemberAdded could stop fetching its JoinResult while other seats stayed digest-only; bounded recovery fetches the missing certificates.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop sending gossip to peers with no transport connection and pin ant-quic =0.27.54
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: x0x kept sending to unconnected peers and ant-quic logged a WARN each time, flooding syslog by about 16 GB a day; skipping those sends and the newer ant-quic stop the flood.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fail closed when plane keys are in the wrong config section and actually show config validation findings
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Misplaced keys could weaken plane isolation without notice, and validation findings were computed but never displayed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop the raw 0x10 path delivering messages from Blocked senders and stop unverified typed frames appearing as DMs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Blocked peers could still get messages through the raw path, and unverified typed frames leaked to users as normal direct messages.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make x0x upgrade --apply refuse and point to the authenticated POST /upgrade/apply endpoint
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The standalone installer could replace x0xd after an unauthenticated shutdown and restart it with self-update off. x0x upgrade --check still works read-only.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Reset forwarded streams when no ForwardService is registered instead of hanging
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Dispatch queued the stream in an undrained default sink, so the forwarder waited forever for a connect-response byte; resetting gives a prompt failure.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make file-transfer and TreeKEM Welcome listeners require a verified sender id
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: They trusted DirectMessage.sender even when the transport said verified = false, so a peer could pretend to be another agent.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Move the rsyslog backup out of /etc/logrotate.d and fix endpostrotate to endscript
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: logrotate no longer sees duplicate claims on /var/log/syslog and can parse the stanza, so the log cap works.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Clear a group's fork quarantine only after the change is durably saved
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: If the clear was applied in memory but not persisted, a crash could leave state inconsistent; gating it on a durable write keeps quarantine status correct.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse to start a named instance that has a config file but no network_id
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Without a network_id the instance could join the wrong network; failing at startup forces the setting to be explicit.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let raw-path delivery count a sender as verified when it is in the authenticated-binding registry
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Messages from senders already proven through the binding registry were treated as unverified on the raw path; checking the registry fixes that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-announce identity when a peer reconnects and return RecipientUndiscovered when the recipient is unknown
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A stopgap: a fresh announce after reconnect lets the other side discover the identity again, and a clear error replaces a vague failure when the recipient is still not found.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Propose ADR 0089 so relationship-peer evidence survives a restart
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Keeping peer evidence across restarts lets the node verify known peers immediately; this PR is the design only.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fail the owner-sync session when the Home-pointer mint fails
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Failing closed stops the peer treating the empty sync as proof no Home exists.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep a verified 'lacks bit' through card imports and ask for missing bits on strict refresh
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Verified negative information is not overwritten by unverified card data, and upgraded peers get re-queried.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make registry bindings honour supersession and keep certificate expiry
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A newer binding replaces the old machine's, and expiry stays known after cache eviction.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop the r19/r17 fixtures racing their own startup announcement
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test fixtures now wait correctly, making the result deterministic; test-only change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Republish the signed base inside the convergence barrier and count publishes that reached zero peers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A single best-effort gossip publish can reach no peers (fanout 0), so the base never arrives and the wait times out; retrying inside the wait makes the state actually show up.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep every group state commit and expose it via GET /groups/:id/state/commits
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Each commit is stored with a roster snapshot whose BLAKE3 roster_root must match the signed one, so who held which role at any revision can be audited later.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the join result carry the intervening membership events
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The second joiner gets the missing event and can apply the later one.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop a not_member row from swallowing a fresh invite
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A leftover not_member record for a group caused a new invite to that group to be ignored. It now gets processed. Fix led to a re-tag of v0.46.0.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep Cargo.lock with LF line endings on Windows checkouts
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The Windows release failed with "tracked source differs from checkout" because git converted Cargo.lock to CRLF. Forcing LF keeps it identical to the committed file.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Accept the GNU sha256sum binary-mode marker (*) when checking release archive checksums
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Release signing failed with "archive checksum mismatch: x0x-windows-x64.zip" because the parser did not accept the '*' prefix sha256sum adds in binary mode.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop all Agent and ExecService background tasks in ServerHandle::shutdown_and_wait()
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With no task left running, an embedder can start, stop and restart x0x in the same process cleanly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Extract only an exact-basename, regular-file, single, magic-checked binary entry
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Extra entries like ._x0xd no longer match.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Persist every fork-quarantine clear before publishing it
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Saving first means a restart never disagrees with what peers were told.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the startup update check after the API binds
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The API is available right away and the check no longer delays it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Remove the dead BootstrapConnector type
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Removal only, no behaviour change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Publish group plaintext task deltas only while holding the publication permit
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A concurrent PATCH /groups/:id/policy flip takes the gss_publication_gate write lock, so holding the permit and re-checking stops plaintext leaking after encryption.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Force-cancel in-flight exec sessions and kill their child processes on shutdown
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: No remote command keeps running after an in-process embedder stops x0x.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-arm stuck joins and guard current-roster serving
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A stuck join can be retried and roster serving is guarded.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the startup update check wait out the systemd start-rate window
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Running after the window means the restart guard no longer blocks it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin saorsa-gossip 0.5.87
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The fix for this issue was shipped by moving to that saorsa-gossip release (in x0x v0.46.2).

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Deliver only verified messages with an identified sender to applications
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Messages whose sender could not be verified or identified reached apps. Red tests were added first, then the fix.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Never overwrite a revocation store file that cannot be decoded
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A file that does not decode is refused and left untouched, so a read error cannot wipe the revocation set.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add an e2e fixture that removes or bans a member on GSS and TreeKEM groups and checks the survivors rekey.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The fixture confirms survivors can still decrypt after the rekey and the excluded member cannot; it is test tooling only (Python fixture and unit tests), no product code.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Treat an anonymous owner announce as no disclosure in the Home-scope check
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: This lets a promoted admin admit members while the owner is offline. The change first flips a red test to expect success, then adds the fix.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Accept EvidenceV1 from relationship peers (same group roster, same owner, or grant counterparty) at Unknown trust.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Blocked peers are still refused and the evidence must still verify, so related peers can share evidence without becoming contacts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Send a deferred first Hello once relationship readiness arrives (opt-in via X0X_EVIDENCE_READY_HELLO=1)
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A Hello skipped at connect because related() was false was never revisited; a readiness check now sends it later.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the metadata listener running for a member that is still active after an exiting apply
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An apply for an exiting state could tear down the metadata listener of a member that was still in the group. Only a test case was added at this stage; the fix follows.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Allow one new Hello per new connection generation, including after a remote close
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The Hello-sent marker only cleared on a local PeerDisconnected, so after a peer restarted the node only sent ACKs and the peer never got its record. A new connection generation now resets it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Have the owner's removal notice wait, with a time limit, for a member that just restarted
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A member restarting cold could miss the removal notice. The owner now waits a bounded time for it to come back before giving up. Shipped in v0.46.4.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the history boot backfill scan each row once and open the database off the async worker.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Removing the quadratic rescan and moving the open off the async runtime stops the roughly 2 minute boot stall on a large history.db.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep a surviving member's GSS group store while its rekey share is still pending
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: After a member was removed from a GSS group, a survivor could permanently lose its encrypted store because it was dropped before the new key share arrived.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Abandon in-flight dials during in-process shutdown and stop waiting on held node guards.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Pending dials and read guards were keeping the socket owner alive; dropping them lets the UDP socket be released and shutdown finish.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the history reaper's byte cap converge without deleting too much
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The reaper's byte cap never settled under the limit. It now deletes until the cap is met and stops, rather than looping or over-deleting.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Recover records that arrived during a GSS rekey gap and break an AppState reference cycle
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Records sent while a surviving member waited for its rekey share are now repaired into its store. A cycle through the GSS hook that leaked AppState at shutdown was also removed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Break the references that kept AppState and Agent alive after shutdown_and_wait following group joins and TreeKEM stores.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Once they are dropped, the exclusive history.db lock is released, so an in-process relaunch on the same data dir no longer waits over 60 s.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse inserts into the session registry once teardown has started.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A teardown flag stops late sends from re-adding sessions, so no stale session handle survives shutdown.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Shield listener-driven group-state applies from the shutdown abort so they finish persisting.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Listeners were aborted after 2 s, or at once for the member-certificate bridge; protecting the apply step prevents torn writes and leftover temp files.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Skip a [[history.scope_limits]] entry whose scope fails to parse instead of aborting the retention pass.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The rest of the pass, including the whole-database byte cap and cleanup_canonical_ids, still runs, so one config typo no longer stops retention.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Drain the remaining detached group tasks during shutdown.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Routing these tasks through the shutdown drain makes them finish and release their AppState references before shutdown returns.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require the joiner to decrypt a message sealed after it joined before calling a private join ready.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Only a joiner that holds the TreeKEM epoch key can decrypt, so a missing Welcome (decrypt 424, TreeKEM group not loaded) now makes the check time out instead of passing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the daemon log, setup command and stderr when Home fixture setup times out, and retry the step once.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The error now names the failing step (start, readiness probe, identity or join) so later failures can be diagnosed, and the single retry covers a transient timeout.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Honour the Call ShareGrant in the outbound call gate too
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both gates now use the same OwnerTrust::grant_access lookup, and a Connect grant is passed into the outbound ACL check.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse legacy imports larger than the retained image cap
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Rejecting at import time stops storing data that can never be served.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the public-group bootstrap outbox step inside the shielded shutdown drain
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The step holds the membership lock while waiting for an application ACK. Run outside the drain, a parked send kept AppState alive past shutdown.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Reword .config/nextest.toml to mark the load cause as unverified and add a CI check for that wording
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The thread reservations stay, but the file no longer states an unproven cause; scripts/ci/check-nextest-load-attribution.py keeps the old claim from returning.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Count a pruned incomplete retained image and send a StateRequest to fetch it again
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The holder serves the full image again, with a second retry after cooldown.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a test proving mutually enrolled owner devices complete SyncV1 sessions both ways
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The session now relies on the verified enrollment alone, since neither discovery cache knows the other agent; earlier failures came from cache lookups or responder resets.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Split SKILL.md into a core file plus topic pages and enforce token budgets in CI
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: just check-skill-size fails above 8,000 tokens for the core and 4,000 per topic page.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Mark only the test item itself as test code in check-panics.sh, ending the region at its closing delimiter.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A span counts as test-only when a known test attribute (#[cfg(test)], #[test], #[tokio::test] and similar) is found and its item's closing brace is matched, so later production code is scanned again.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Join WebSocket sessions into the shutdown drain
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: WebSocket sessions are now waited on during shutdown. A history backfill still reading stays owned, and shutdown reports that release as incomplete instead of hiding it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Join the REST /subscribe forwarder tasks on shutdown.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Waiting for these forwarders to end stops them holding daemon state past shutdown; it covers only that one remaining owner.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check the exact per-peer attempt count and frame length for a known deferred EAGER retry in the meter test.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A live in-process publish forces one deferred IWANT reply, so the expected count is known; doubling or dropping a retry now fails the check.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Carry a validated MessageHeader.msg_id onto live frames as transport_msg_id when it is safe
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The id is only copied when exactly one producer queued one payload; recovery, cancelled producers and failed verification omit it, so the id is never attached to the wrong message.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Record each node's x0xd sha256 and allow mixed binaries with --mixed
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Each node is checked against its own deployed binary.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Return HistoryError::Locked when history.db is already held by another opener.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Mapping the locked pragma error to the documented variant lets callers detect the case; a test now checks the variant.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make HistoryHandle::store() crate-only and have purge take the retention admission.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Outside callers can no longer bypass the recording gate; this is a breaking library change shipped in 0.47.0.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make durable writes report whether a failure happened before or after the rename
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Callers can then keep in-memory state when the data is already on disk, matching what survives restart.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop reporting success when a peer silently drops a file offer
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A new file_control_ack_v1 capability bit (1 << 3) is used. When the peer advertises it, a missing ack returns HTTP 500 and marks the offer Failed instead of claiming it was delivered.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the named-groups journal, snapshots and API results in agreement after a write fault
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Fault paths now leave restart state matching what the API reported.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let a SignedPublic group member one revision behind catch up from the signer of the next head
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The signer sends the lagging member a bootstrap snapshot under the per-group membership lock, and skips it when the group is fork-quarantined, so stale members can recover.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Seed the HyParView JOIN only with peers the gossip plane gate admitted
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Seeds came from transport dial results, so a cached peer on another gossip plane became a seed and was re-dialled up to ten times, delaying presence. Fixed with saorsa-gossip 0.5.88.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Use the merge-base with GITHUB_BASE_SHA for the ADR count check on pull requests
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: On a force-push, GITHUB_BEFORE points to a commit no longer in the checkout, so the check failed. Pull requests now ignore GITHUB_BEFORE; pushes still use it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse GroupCards with invalid signatures at discovery before caching them
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Unsigned or badly signed cards were written into group_card_cache and directory_cache. They are now refused and counted at ingress, and read routes no longer run ML-DSA while holding the cache lock.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require a seated actor or the durable API token on group routes that were unchecked
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: PUT /groups/:id/display-name now needs an active seat in the group. Quarantine clear, join-request listing and all /mls/groups* routes need the durable API token.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Classify the x0x.revocation.v1, v2 and v3 topics as Critical so they are never shed
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: They were Normal, so a Leaf using shed_normal could drop revocations. The names match exactly with ==, so look-alike topics such as x0x.revocation.v10 stay Normal.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Quarantine a corrupt revocation store and keep membership closed until it resyncs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: x0xd moves the bad file to <file>.quarantined-<unix-ms>, keeps running, and flags revocation_resync_required in status.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Rekey TreeKEM when a member leaves a group on its own
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Self-leave only removed the member from the roster, so it could still decrypt. The lowest active admin now commits a TreeKEM rekey, and the signed roster names the commit digest so relays can check it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Retire ended join attempts
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Removing finished attempts lets remove + re-invite work without a restart.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a regression test for a fresh admission after a refused join
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test makes sure a valid invitation works after an earlier refusal.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Wrap each bootstrap dial attempt in tokio::time::timeout
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: connect_addr has no reliable internal timeout, so one black-holed bootstrap address stalled BootstrapConnector::connect_with_retry forever and it never moved on to the next peer.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the delivered-removal test leg finish or fail visibly
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test can no longer pass by silently skipping that path; harness-only change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Put the delegation_spaces binary in the nextest quic-localhost test group with max-threads = 1.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: nextest runs each test in its own process, so the in-process suite_lock could not serialise them and several meshes formed at once on one loopback network; zero-peer failures are now also classified.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin ant-quic =0.27.60
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The new ant-quic release is the dependency step for this fix.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Read the revocation stores at delivery time instead of copying them when a subscription opens
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A subscription opened before the stores were attached kept empty copies forever, so it delivered messages from revoked or Blocked senders.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply revocation and Blocked checks on every stored-message read and backfill path.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: GET /groups/:id/messages, GET /history and its variants, WebSocket topic backfill, /ws/direct?backfill=N and GET /direct/events?backfill=N now hide such authors at read time; rows stay stored and reappear if the author is allowed again.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Replace the dead unreachable!() arms in the x0x CLI with explicit errors.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The arms are only dead because of an early return; returning an error instead means a future refactor fails cleanly rather than panicking.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Register CRDT and KV sync tasks with the Agent so Agent::shutdown() stops them
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: TaskListSync::start and KvStoreSync::start used bare tokio::spawn and dropped the JoinHandles, so the loops kept running after shutdown until the gossip runtime dropped the topic.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Send the JSON field names the API routes actually read from the GUI
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The MLS encrypt pane sent plaintext instead of base64 payload, causing 422; decrypt read the wrong field; display-name sent display_name instead of name. The GUI now matches the routes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Update rustls in Cargo.lock from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46 to close RUSTSEC-2026-0346 to 0349
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A semver-compatible lockfile-only update; Cargo.toml and the ant-quic pin are unchanged. cargo update -p rustls --precise 0.23.46 also moved an unrelated getrandom edge.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Count the plane legacy grace per connection generation, not per peer
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A cross-plane seed sometimes let a JOIN succeed after 8 failed attempts (about 1 run in 70 in cross_plane_join_seeds.rs). Tracking the grace per connection generation stops the retry from slipping through.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add tests for the exec ACL denial paths and raise the coverage floor to match.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The deny paths had no unit tests; covering them lifted real coverage above 65%, so the CI floor could be ratcheted up to just under the actual value.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Only let a cached group card be replaced by a card from the same authority
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A cached discovery card is replaced or withdrawn only by a card signed with the same key in revision order, by an active admin in the local roster, or by the owner the cached card names.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop labelling each request's delivery transport by guessing from trace order
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: When direct frames and request draining interleave, trace order cannot tell whether a request came by direct or gossip delivery, so the receipt no longer claims one.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Use one token class for join-request list, approve and reject
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: These routes now need the same token class as the other routes that seat or remove members (add, remove, role change, ban, invite), so permissions are consistent.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Accept a decrypt response when ok is true and the payload is a string, including the empty string.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The pane then replaces the old plaintext; failed or non-string payloads still leave it unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Discard a saved owner token rejected with 401, try the session token once, then prompt if needed.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The bad token is no longer reused, a rejected replacement is also discarded, and a late response cannot erase a newer token.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require the durable owner token for POST /groups/secure/open-envelope
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A browser session could ask the daemon to return a decrypted group secret. Session and rider credentials now get a JSON 403 before the body is parsed, and the handler re-checks ownership.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Raise the Signing path 100k CI job timeout to 45 minutes
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test passed in about 29 minutes but the job hit its 30-minute limit during post-cache steps; more headroom stops the cancellations.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply named-group metadata per group instead of inline on the shared direct listener
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: run_direct_metadata_listener awaited each apply, so one group waiting on a Welcome fetch (up to WELCOME_FETCH_TIMEOUT, 115 s) stalled metadata for every other group on the daemon.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Detect a one-sided peer link (traffic only in one direction) and re-dial it
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A peer counts as one-sided when one direction of application data is at least 60 s old and the other at most 10 s old. Quiet peers stay up; /health, /status and /peers report degraded with a reason.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep GroupCard signature refusal details in debug logs during the warning cooldown
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Warnings are limited to once a minute, so refusals in between vanished. Their group ID, cumulative count and verification error are now logged at debug level during that window.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Register the SIGTERM handler in x0xd before the HTTP server starts accepting
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A SIGTERM sent right after startup could arrive before the handler existed. Registration now happens before serve_with_options and a failure stops startup; X0X_CHILD_DIAGNOSTICS records the timing for tests.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add x0x doctor --json with one summary and a non-zero exit when any check fails.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It covers connectivity, key health, store integrity and upgrade state; warnings alone still exit zero, and text mode uses the same exit rule.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Write the quarantine fallback copy to a temp file and rename it into place
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A crash during the copy no longer leaves a truncated quarantine file, because the rename only happens once the full bytes are written.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require Arc<SigningContext> in every PubSubManager constructor and GossipRuntime::new.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With no way to pass None, the normal publish path always signs messages; the unsigned V1 encoder now exists only in test builds.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: fsync the quarantine copy and its directory before deleting the live file
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The copy is written durably (fsync file, rename, fsync parent dir) before the live file is removed. If the sync fails, the live file is kept, so a crash cannot lose both copies.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add per-kind gossip counters to GET /diagnostics/gossip
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Counters for each PlumTree message kind are reported for current and last completed intervals.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse gossip messages whose inner V1 message is unsigned, even if the outer signature is valid
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A valid outer machine signature could wrap an unsigned inner V1 message. The topic validator now drops these before content checks or relay fan-out and counts them in relay_fanout.unsigned_inner_v1_dropped.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bump zip from 2.4.2 to 9.0.4 to clear RUSTSEC-2026-0367, 0368 and 0369 in cargo audit
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The new version fixes the advisories. ZipFile::name now returns a Result, so the extract path decodes the name first, still copies only the matching binary as mode 0o755, and skips symlinks.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Build the Tokio runtime by hand in x0xd with thread_stack_size of 8 MiB instead of #[tokio::main].
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Worker and blocking threads get the same 8 MiB as the main thread; it is only a virtual reservation, so memory is used only when needed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the admin role gate before the B8 precondition in approve_join_request on the GSS path.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Non-admins now get 403 first, matching the TreeKEM path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Update the local full, CLI and named-groups e2e scripts to match current behaviour.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Test scripts only; no source changes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Enable only the deflate feature of the zip crate
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The upgrade extractor only needs stored and deflated entries (Windows release archives use deflate). zip 9.0.4 with default-features = false and features = ["deflate"] drops unused dependency crates.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Put a timeout on the first discovery-cache read in the direct-send preflight
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: That read could wait forever behind a writer before any transport timeout started. It now uses the timeout_per_attempt budget and returns the retryable RecipientUndiscovered error when it expires.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Ask for a TreeKEM catch-up when traffic arrives from a newer epoch than the local one
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A member offline during a removal rekey missed the commit and stayed on the old epoch, failing with "Invalid epoch: expected N, got N+1". Seeing epoch-ahead traffic now triggers catch-up, not only membership events.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bound send evidence work without falling back to blocking calls
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Keeps evidence work during sends within a time bound so it cannot block the async executor.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the test harness wall clock pull-based and run blocking work inline under the shim
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A stale ticker clock and wakeups from the blocking pool caused nondeterministic ordering and a dropped LinkClosed JoinResult; it does not claim every divergence source is gone.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the announcement auto-connect window on the runtime clock
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Using wall time made a test setup barrier fail in the deterministic harness; the runtime clock makes it reproducible.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Classify not_member join rows with no invite_lineage as JoinFailed instead of success
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: These leftover rows returned join_state: not_member as a success with no way to recover. They are now refused with the existing CONFLICT error body.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Derive the creator of a v4 invite from its signed creator field.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The function no longer depends on the legacy fat roster, so v4 invites work.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Take an exclusive file lock beside each target during self-update and skip backup/replace if bytes already match.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the catch-up throttle on the runtime clock instead of wall time
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A deterministic harness test failed about 1 in 10 to 20 runs with expected Green, got Some(Red), because the throttle used a clock the simulated runtime did not control.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a structured v1 verdict to the server /health endpoint.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give evidence-worker shutdown a five-second drain deadline and continue cleanup
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A read stuck behind a writer made the unbounded join hang Agent::try_shutdown. Now unfinished handles are kept, cleanup continues, and an incomplete-shutdown NodeError reports how many were left.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let a verified invite replace an inert card-import stub that matches on group id.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Remove the synchronous evidence-store read for peers with no addresses in connect_to_agent
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A held store mutex could freeze the Tokio worker so the caller's timeout never fired.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Move the pinned-recipient EvidenceRuntime::lookup reads off the Tokio executor
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The synchronous store and policy reads could block on a held mutex, so the resolver's absolute deadline and caller cancellation never fired.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bound authority evidence reads in OwnerTrust::authority_confirms_with
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: EvidenceRuntime::confirms_pairing could block a Tokio worker behind a held evidence mutex, so cancellation, timers and relationship-change tasks could not run.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Correct /health reason text and probe diagnostics accounting without changing the JSON fields
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Follow-ups from review of the structured /health verdict; the payload stays additive-only, with only the human-readable reason and diagnostics counts corrected.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bound the three synchronous evidence reads in raw recipient resolution
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Initial selection, the machine-pinned check after repair, and the connected-machine check after redial could block a Tokio worker, stopping timers and cancellation from running.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Move background Lookup evidence and policy reads off the Tokio worker
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: These blocking reads stalled a worker, so a current-thread runtime could not run caller timers and enough Lookups could stall a multithread runtime.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make x0xd --check-updates report-only and have x0x upgrade --apply delegate to the daemon's POST /upgrade/apply.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The serving daemon stays the only writer of binaries, so CLI and daemon cannot install at the same time.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add an agent-usability eval in tests/agent_usability_eval.rs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It boots two daemons, runs x0x onboard, reads the core SKILL.md and checks a scripted agent completes the tasks.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Tear down live forward streams within five seconds when their authority is revoked or expires.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Streams are closed on trust-loss events, so access ends promptly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Record a loopback measurement of bytes per frame and verifies per second, v0.45.0 against v0.48.1.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The result is committed under proofs/ as evidence; the fleet measurement on real hosts stays with ops.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a W3-H harness case for a stale-base TreeKEM joiner in an ownerless group with a skewed roster clock.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add W3-H case src/server/w3h/case_1023.rs for an admin restart with all evidence holders offline.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It expects a typed wait that resumes on main, and a control shows one online holder is enough to admit the joiner.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the signing-acceptance build within the hosted CI runner's memory limit

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a local version and policy digest plus an owner machine census, with no wire change.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The owner ruling chose a local-only approach rather than adding the digest to signed announcements.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a persisted unenroll tombstone and re-check enrollment mid-session
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The tombstone stops the device being trusted again, and an aborted session stops writing and drops its streams; no new wire frames or REST changes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Exclude x0x_0041_prefer_newest_test from the coverage gate run.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Timing-sensitive tests are unreliable under coverage instrumentation, so this mirrors existing exclusions for similar timing tests.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add minimum supported version and support window fields, left unset.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The fields exist for later use. A first copy of this PR triggered zero CI runs, so it was recreated with an empty commit.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Probe both candidate binaries before replacing the installed ones.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A candidate that fails the probe is caught before the swap.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Persist forwards in forwards.json pinned to a MachineId, with --ephemeral to opt out.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A create is not accepted until the save succeeds, cancelling a listener also closes its connections, and GET /forwards shows saved forwards as disabled when connect is off.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a journaled pair transaction for the daemon and CLI binaries with retained backups.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Integer math keeps the delay within its bounds.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add ADR 0110 S4 revocation eviction with the designated member first; adopt verified renewals of its own certificate.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0381, -0382 and -0383 with a lockfile-only change; the ant-quic pin stays at =0.27.61 and no advisories are ignored.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep durable per-participant rollout receipts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Preserve the startup staging window across restarts.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A restart no longer resets the rollout wait.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Parse supplied account sources without using ambient NSS.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Parse supplied unit commands as bounded literal evidence.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the production fleet staging minimum in the startup staging path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Honour staging for HTTP apply and add the approved --now override.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Gives one controlled way to skip the wait.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Gives room for the added cases; this is a capacity limit, not slow code.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep not_after on synced issuance journal lines.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Test that ShareGrant Connect { ports } allows only the granted port through forwards and SOCKS.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let an owner-trusted agent show a validated GUI view on an enrolled machine, including the owner's active one.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the w3h_1023 fixtures only in the W3-H harness tier.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Limit code generation memory in the signing acceptance build.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Time-limit the share-grant gate's candidates snapshot read and cap concurrent readers

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bound producer-drain retries and the flush-worker join.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Bounds stop shutdown hanging on a stuck worker.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: ADR-0061 says support is established by versioned templates and loaded-policy readback, not by a marker alone; generating the template from autostart provides that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run GUI show displays off the receive loop

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse TreeKEM catch-up pages to a revoked requester.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check group membership in task-list REST handlers for group-scoped topics.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Ids of the form x0x.group.<group_id>.symphony.<list_id> are now only accessible to members of that group, giving real cross-daemon isolation.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: End the old process after the bounded reply attempt once a socket flush succeeds.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The control loop now stops the old process even when the requester disconnects or the shutdown tail stays parked, so the success path always completes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Publish idle-ready only from the runtime park hook, not from the idle recheck
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The recheck now wakes the reactor with a loopback datagram. A recheck in the gap between driver wake and after_unpark could otherwise run the barrier ahead of a queued task.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add bounded, I/O-free private parsers for supplied procfs stat, status credentials and mountinfo bytes.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The parsers tolerate opaque command and path bytes while extracting process identity and checking the supplied mount view, with no file access of their own.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse a write that meets a damaged replay log, and add a head rule and a newest-two bound.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Refusing the write keeps the damaged .crblog/.orclog intact for inspection (ADR 0085 rule 4) instead of overwriting the evidence.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse unattested DMs from an agent once the receiver knows one of its machines was revoked.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: When a revoked machine can be attributed to the sender, the DM inbox requires the sender's device (origin) attestation, so a revoked device can no longer pass; the wire format is unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a fault-injection test that a failed re-seat swap tree write restores the original snapshot state.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test a_failed_swap_tree_write_restores_the_originals_snapshot_state forces the write to fail and checks the restore, so a regression is caught.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add private parsers for process argv and root environment from supplied Linux process bytes.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: They keep argument boundaries and empty non-leading arguments, and select only HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME and X0X_HOME without reading the controller's environment.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Store the admission count the finish hook compared, instead of reading the counter again
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Under paused test time, re-reading the counter let a newly admitted blocking task be excused, so the clock moved while it ran. Storing the checked count keeps the clock still.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make an owner-sealed TreeKEM joiner on a stale base arm its gap gate
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An early return for owner mandates in classify_refused_joiner_fork_chain skipped arming the gap gate. That return was a bug and is removed; no wire or API change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Take join-artifact and Welcome deadlines from tokio's clock
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Deadlines used a different clock than the runtime, so they misbehaved under paused or virtual time in tests. Using tokio's clock keeps them consistent.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make S4 delivery drop decisions read committed roster state in rebind, owner_recovery and removal_delivery::drive
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: These paths decided to drop deliveries using roster state that might not be committed. They now read committed state.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Drain the fixture's detached asks fully before counting startup sends in the test.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The flake was a test setup race, not a product bug; waiting for the fixture's own calls to finish removes the stray count with no sleep or retry.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a re-seat staging slot behind the group map guards.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: First step of the fix: the staged join gets its own slot outside the live map, so the original stays contained until the keyed swap.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-check the live roster in the S4 delivery completion step before closing a seat.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Reading the live roster at completion time stops the step acting on stale membership.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run the staged re-seat join in the staging slot
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The re-seat join now runs in its staging slot rather than the live one, so it does not interfere with the active group state.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Change the intra-doc link [start] to [Self::start] in the harness DaemonFixture docs.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The sentence means DaemonFixture::start, so the qualified link resolves and cargo doc --workspace passes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop local card routes from signing a card for a held-back group
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Local card routes could sign a card for a group that was being held back. They now refuse.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Only adopt a group as Home when it has Home policy and the creator is the sole active member.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The new is_home_recovery_candidate check rules out shared groups with the same policy, so recovery no longer stamps them as Home.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply evidence redaction to all remaining inventory parsers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The rule that inventory evidence is redacted in diagnostics now covers the whole dormant parser family, not just some parsers.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Redact command arguments in restart error messages and Debug output
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A failed supervisor command match printed stored and running argv, and four restart types exposed argv through derived Debug. Restart decisions and stored data are unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give journal record types opaque Debug output so they do not leak arguments or environment values
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Derived Debug on LauncherBinding, Participant, M2HandoffRecord and RecordRead printed command arguments and env values. Serialized data and validation are unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Write the S3 placeholder of an OwnerCertified group into home-suite-groups.json too.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Released binaries let the sidecar entry win, and a crash between the two file writes could leave a mismatch; writing both keeps them consistent.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Send a typed refusal to a catch-up requester whose machine or binding was revoked.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The requester gets an explicit refusal it can act on instead of waiting on a silent drop.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Redact malformed upgrade-record errors in boot diagnostics and handoff logs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Parser errors could include credential-like values from bad records, which were printed at boot and logged from UpgradeHandoff::read. Fixed redacted messages are now used.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let a member republish its KEM key on its own Active seat (X0XKR1).
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A new X0XKR1 record lets the member replace its KEM key in place, with no re-join.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a parser for supplied systemd Unit properties from get-property JSON
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A separate entry point reads FragmentPath, SourcePath, DropInPaths, LoadState, UnitFileState, Transient and NeedDaemonReload from systemd v255 replies. The Service parser still refuses Unit properties.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Rotate the GSS owner-recovery secret from the committed secret epoch
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Owner recovery now rotates from the epoch that was actually committed, so it does not start from a stale or uncommitted epoch.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop re-requesting truncated TreeKEM catch-up pages at once when a page makes no progress.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The was_truncated branch asked for the next page with no throttle or progress check; adding a no-progress stop breaks the timer-free hot loop.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep rebind-sibling fork evidence after a rebind replaces the parent certificate.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Evidence of a fork is kept for later checks.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Restart a request round from a new head immediately instead of after its old backoff.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: When the head changes, the old backoff no longer applies, so the round proceeds at once and the test finishes well under the deadline.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Verify the re-seat KeyPackage against the subject's agent key and refuse with binding_mismatch if evidence is missing.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It fails closed: a receiver with no subject-signed MemberJoined evidence for the package refuses the re-seat.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report a durability preflight refusal as NotReplaced at the root and in crypto_exclusion.rs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Refused writes were reported as successful but not durable. Fixing the root and the remaining sites makes callers see the refusal.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Address named-group answers to the requesting machine and keep the typed refusal for TreeKEM catch-up only.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Machine-addressed answers reach the right device, while the explicit refusal flag (bit 13) stays limited to TreeKEM catch-up.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse a carried MemberJoined event that belongs to a different group
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A check now rejects a MemberJoined carried in another group's data, so one group's membership event cannot be applied to another.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep Home metadata in the S3 placeholder in home-suite-groups.json.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The placeholder had dropped home in both files; released Home-Suite binaries can now parse it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a released-binary test of the Home gate on v0.45.0 and v0.46.1.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It checks Home activation stays off and the group shows recovery_deferred.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop a same-second anonymous announcement from dropping a disclosed owner certificate.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The certificate is kept, so owner-trust gates such as remote GUI show work.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse a transactional socket flush when no restart-capable owner exists
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An arm request for a TransactionalHandoff participant is refused at admission before any shutdown. The daemon keeps serving and nothing is armed, so a retry refuses the same way.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report a CLI installed separately from x0xd as not upgraded in x0x upgrade --check
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The check asks the local daemon's GET /health over loopback (default 127.0.0.1:12700, no proxy or redirect) and compares, so a CLI not updated with the daemon is reported correctly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make POST /home/seat use the canonical Home named in the register
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Resolving the Home from the register instead of local state sends invites into the owner's real Home even if a duplicate exists.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the curl | sh and Windows installers verify the signed ML-DSA-65 release manifest
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The installers now run the same manifest check as the updater and refuse to install when it fails, so a tampered download is not installed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Probe and repair a peer link that is stale in both directions
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A link with no traffic either way is probed to confirm it is dead, then repaired. /status and /health report degraded with a degraded_reason, a public API change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Carry admin certificates in the roster chain so a promoted admin can seal while the creator is offline
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An optional serde-default RosterMemberSnapshot.certificate field carries the certificate over up to two chain links, so the admin's authority can be checked without the creator. State root is unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report a durability preflight refusal in whole-map persist as NotReplaced, not Ok(ReplacedNotDurable)
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: persist_named_groups_mutation_with_gss_guard and persist_named_groups_quarantine_clear_durable_only reported a refused write as if it succeeded. They now report a refusal; no response or wire change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix the H-S3-s64 and H-S3-x test flakes in the W3-H test harness
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both flakes came from the test harness, not the product. Only harness code changed; no product, wire, API, timeout, limit or retry changes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to the exec ACL TOML structs.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: ExecSectionToml, AllowEntryToml and CommandToml now reject unknown keys at load; the root AclFileToml is left open so other top-level sections can coexist.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Split H-S3-c/c2 out of the S3 W3-H shard and make the owner-recovery test wait for its drive.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A smaller shard fits its time limit, and waiting for the drive removes the test's race with itself.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bring the acknowledged flush owner to Windows.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Windows now flushes state before the supervised exit as Unix does.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make S4 wait for the revocation-store write before sealing while the sidecar is memory-only.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Triggers not durable elsewhere now show waiting_for_durable_intake instead of being sealed early.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Cap join-carry ATA signing with the same ResponderBudget::may_sign() budget and a per-requester rate.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The request path (sign_ata) was already capped at 32 signatures per minute; applying the same budget to join_carry_attestation in group_recovery.rs closes the uncapped path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Redact executable and data-root paths in restart refusal messages
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Restart refusals printed local file paths that could reveal private details. These are now hidden in the messages.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep an uncommitted GSS secret only when it comes from the exclusion's actor.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Checking sender provenance stops other peers from injecting a same-epoch secret that the keep-path would trust.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep a verified catching_up state while catch-up is still making progress
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A member in catching_up state could time out even while catch-up was advancing. It now holds as long as progress continues.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Announce a newly observed release on x0x/release only from the apply path
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Release announcements now come from one place, the apply path, so other code paths do not send duplicate or premature announcements.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: End a readmitted joiner's attempt with a typed error when the sealer's Welcome is gone
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: If the Welcome a readmitted joiner needs no longer exists, the attempt now ends with a clear typed reason instead of waiting or failing vaguely.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop unpinned secrets in the GSS share hold from ending its waits.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Only pinned secrets can satisfy a wait; the MemberRemoved/MemberBanned sender check is left for a later change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a test row for the case where the sealer's Welcome is lost after readmission.
