https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: This is the last slice of the fix; the test pins the lost-Welcome-after-readmission scenario so the no-keys loop cannot come back unnoticed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Ask for the authority's advert when a Welcome fetch cannot reach the authority's address
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A Welcome fetch with no usable address for the authority now requests its advert to learn how to reach it, instead of failing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give one of the sender's eager gossip seats to the recipient's own machine for DM inbox topics.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Fresh peers all score the same, so the two eager targets were picked by hash order and often missed the recipient; seating the recipient directly delivers without the fallback.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Compute the re-seat journal record digest over a canonical encoding.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A digest over a canonical encoding gives the same hash for the same record regardless of how it was serialised.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Have a sole admin with an expired certificate wait for its own certificate renewal
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: When the only admin's certificate expired, its row now waits for renewal rather than for another admin that does not exist.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Emit unresolved_designated_admin from the recorded designated hand-off outcome
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The cause was documented but never emitted: every waiting rank showed waiting_for_designated_admin. The row now tells apart "no exchange yet" from a hand-off whose route to the designated admin failed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Set CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG to line-tables-only under GITHUB_ACTIONS.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Less debug info in scripts/ci/nextest-isolated.sh makes the build lighter, so compiling x0x-test-harness no longer gets the job killed; no timeout change needed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop stream opens at the same instant from reordering the trace
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Streams opened at the same timestamp could appear in different order between runs, making traces non-deterministic. Their order is now fixed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop a banned agent from being re-admitted with an invite issued before the ban
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The authority side now refuses an invite created before the agent was banned. Other parts of the problem remain open.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Create named_groups.json and group sidecars with 0600 permissions and tighten existing files on save.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: write_named_groups_json_atomic now sets the mode on the temp file, so the rename never puts a world-readable secret file in place.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-check agent revocation before each TreeKEM catch-up page request
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A revoked agent could keep fetching catch-up pages because revocation was only checked once. It is now checked before each write. A typed refusal still needs a wire change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make a timed-out join report its last cause, or no_admission_result if there was none
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A join that timed out gave no reason. It now returns TimedOut(<cause>) or no_admission_result, so callers can tell why it failed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let a joiner that has not yet received its Welcome apply TreeKEM-commit page links as state-only
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Inside an armed catch-up sequence, a pre-Welcome joiner records these links without needing keys, so it can follow the chain once the Welcome arrives. First slice of the work.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a per-message revocation check to the raw-QUIC direct DM listener, failing closed.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The listener marked messages verified and trusted but never checked revocation, and revoking does not close a live connection, so each message must be checked.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add machine-id revocation checks to the gossip DM inbox to match the direct path.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both DM paths now refuse messages from revoked machines, closing the gap between them.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give each named daemon instance its own default connect-ACL path
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Co-located prod, testnet and other daemons all used /etc/x0x/connect-acl.toml unless --connect-acl was set, so editing one plane's security policy silently changed the others.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply a batch of six low-cost defense-in-depth fixes across the daemon.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: None were remotely exploitable (all auth-gated, loopback-bound or opt-in), but each fix closes a gap cheaply before it can matter.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Authenticate the agent_id before applying the tailnet inbound forward ACL.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Using an authenticated agent identity lets per-agent rules be enforced instead of trusting whatever agent the machine claims.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Enforce require_contact_to_relay and add per-peer rate and bandwidth limits to PeerRelay
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Without them any peer could use the relay and flood it; the feature is off by default, but the limits must exist before anyone turns it on.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Wire up the runtime expiry gate, gossip issuer revocation and pubsub RevocationSet checks, all failing closed.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: On any uncertainty, such as a missing cert, unverifiable revocation state or expired cert, the path now denies instead of allows.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Strip TreeKEM KeyPackages from invite links and let joiners fetch them by member instead
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Each member added about 17 KiB of keys to the invite, so the join message passed the 49 152-byte gossip cap at the third member and later joins failed with envelope_construction errors.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Split the integration job into parallel core and net jobs and move slow timing suites to a weekly run.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: About ten suites ran one after another in one capped job, including slow ignored-only timing suites; splitting and scheduling them keeps each job within its limit.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Upgrade to ant-quic 0.27.30 and saorsa-gossip 0.5.66.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The new dependency versions carry the fixes for the gossip dispatcher backlog and for the Instant subtraction panic shortly after Windows boot.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Persist verified, self-signed MemberJoined events to disk as a TreeKEM member recovery cache
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: After a restart the records are authenticated and restored, then served through the existing member-keyed catch-up path, so peers can still recover membership. Writes are atomic and serialized with live inserts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Trust an AgentId to MachineId binding only from a directly observed, verified v2 identity announcement
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Rebroadcast announcements still help discovery but can no longer fill or overwrite the security cache used for machine revocation, and far-future announcements beyond the 30-second clock-skew limit are rejected.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Charge relay quotas only after send_direct_typed succeeds, and release reservations on any failure
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Quota is reserved atomically, then committed on success and released automatically on send, encoding, cancellation or early-return failures, so failed forwards no longer eat quota. limit_window_ms = 0 is clamped to the 1 ms minimum.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a validated InstanceName type shared by CLI and config, and resolve precedence before deriving the ACL path
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: default_connect_acl_path_for now requires a validated name, replacing a debug_assert! that did nothing in release builds, so a bad merged instance name cannot produce a wrong connect-ACL path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Quarantine malformed TreeKEM recovery-cache files and replace the raw map with one bounded cache
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Bad or schema-incompatible cache files are moved aside as evidence instead of crashing, while other filesystem errors stay fatal. The cache prunes, compacts by count and bytes, and drops its lock before disk I/O so writers do not block each other.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let a promoted admin remove a compromised TreeKEM member without the original inviter, and serialise recovery writes.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Witnesses now keep the signed MemberJoined evidence, and package installation no longer races GroupInfo write-back and named_groups.json snapshots.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Close the v0.30.1 convergence-test gaps in KV ownership, restart persistence, structured claims and soak harness.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Five reviewed work packages fix every defect from the three-machine convergence test.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Advertise 4,096 concurrent uni streams instead of 50,000.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: ant-quic allocates a slot per advertised remote stream when a connection is built, so 50,000 cost about 1.6 MB per connection, even for failed dials.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the Phase-D smoke test wait for an authority-committed join before peers post.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Posting before the join was committed made the joiner's post fail and its message miss its own cache.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Drop stale owner deltas at or below the adopted checkpoint high-water mark.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A fresh relay-only joiner replayed old deltas from gossip and brought back keys the owner had deleted.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Share one bootstrap cache between x0x and the ant-quic transport.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: ant-quic silently opened a second cache in a host-shared default directory ($TMPDIR/ant-quic-cache or ~/.cache/ant-quic), and the two never shared data.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix the restart rehydration wedge, the zombie subscription and the policy misreport from v0.33.0.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Three restart-recovery defects were found by a two-daemon harness and fixed together.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Sweep stale manifest .tmp files so cancelled or crashed writes cannot leak them forever.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The root race (async temp-file create finishing after the guard drops) was fixed by creating the file synchronously before the first await; a bounded sweep cleans up any remaining debris.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Split the catch-all DM envelope error into retryable statuses and make the cmd-DM group join idempotent.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: DmError::EnvelopeConstruction mapped three different causes (oversized payload, bad cached KEM key, crypto faults) to 400; correct statuses allow retries, and repeat joins are safe.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add attestation denial logging and a codec round-trip tamper test suite.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The cross-node denial was already fixed by validating the attestation recipient locally; this makes future denials observable.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check the reconnect-suppression tombstone in the inbound accept loop, not just on outbound dials.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Inbound accept only checked the allowlist, so a tombstoned peer could redial in and be readmitted; outbound paths already honoured suppression.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Rewrite the reconnect and timeout tests to check load-independent invariants with realistic deadlines.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: They raced setup churn (a late PeerConnected cancelled the reconnect) and used 20 s deadlines below the real worst case of about 62 s (backoff, jitter and dial timeouts).

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Document the pubsub sender-auth invariant and audit saorsa-gossip's receive path.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: msg.sender and msg.verified come only from the end-to-end ML-DSA-65 signature, so a relay cannot forge an origin without its private key; the transport hop is never used as sender.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add an opt-in coarse origin token (observed_prefix, direct, cgnat) to DM surfaces, off by default.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With observed_prefix_enabled false the fields are absent and output is byte-identical; when on, IPv4 is masked to /24 and IPv6 to /48 before formatting, and loopback addresses are never shown.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a StateServedV2 digest and frontier handshake as convergence evidence for recovery.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Requesters can verify a digest of what was served instead of just trusting that a holder responded, closing the gaps left without checkpoints.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Gate mDNS and bootstrap cache paths by gossip plane so co-located planes stay isolated.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Daemons on different planes on the same host were leaking into each other through mDNS and a shared cache.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Split src/server/mod.rs into per-route submodules with no behaviour change.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Routes like status, files, exec, connect, groups and trust move into their own modules following routes/tasks.rs, with tests moved alongside; mod.rs keeps only wiring and router assembly (27,836 to 1,623 lines).

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report degraded /health on sustained zero peers and add an opt-in zero-peer restart watchdog.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A node stuck with no peers now shows up in monitoring and can restart itself.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bump ant-quic to 0.27.35 to reap zombie connections.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The new ant-quic release kills connections to departed peers that keep sending but never ACK.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Use connect_peer_with_addrs with the peer id for every proactive reconnect and cache-fallback dial.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Passing the PeerId lets hole punching work and makes the dial peer-authenticated, so a stale cached address pointing at a different peer is rejected.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Poll the group authority after a non-TreeKEM join until membership is confirmed.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The joiner records the expected inviter and keeps checking for the 10-minute MemberAdded retention window, so a missed commit gets repaired.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Count and WARN on public messages dropped by write-policy rejection or failed transport verification.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both drops were silent on the server side; the HTTP 403 and drop behaviour stay the same but are now visible.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bump ant-quic to 0.27.36 and set mdns_namespace from the gossip plane id.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: This picks up the InFlight-underflow silent send stall fix, and daemons on different planes (prod/testnet/test) on one LAN stop auto-connecting via mDNS.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check the connected peer id matches before any cache bookkeeping on a dial.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: On mismatch connect_peer_with_addrs closes the impostor connection, records a failure for the stale entry and returns an error with no success recorded.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Save the peer's observed address in machine_discovery_cache on PeerConnected.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: PeerConnected only marked the peer connected; storing its address gives the reconnect loop a candidate to dial.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Ship six ops-correctness fixes as 0.37.2 without changing the send contract.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The fixes were picked out of a larger branch, leaving out durable-ACK and the bootstrap outbox so the release stays low risk.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add the GET /history/message/:msg_id point lookup route.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The route clients were already calling now exists, so lookups return real results instead of a silent 404.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Publish durable ACKs from a bounded background publisher instead of inline in the inbox loop.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Moving the publish off the inbox loop keeps message handling flowing; v2 ACKs are also always mirrored onto the compatibility bus.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Resend a lost MemberJoined notice from the join-result poll
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: If the MemberJoined notice was lost, members never saw the new joiner. Polling for the join result now triggers a resend.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add bounded resends for MemberRemoved and GroupDeleted, plus a hermetic test plane
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: These notices were sent once at most, so a peer that missed one never learned it was removed or the group was deleted. Bounded resends fix the gap.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add bounded two-channel redelivery for MemberBanned notices
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Ban notices were sent once with no repair, so a banned peer that missed it kept its roster entry and stale TreeKEM keys forever. Bounded resends over two channels make delivery reliable.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give the test harness cluster and DaemonFixture a hermetic gossip plane.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Test daemons no longer discover the live mesh, so results do not depend on other x0xd instances on the machine.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Include the resolved database path in errors from pragma setup
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Errors during SQLite pragma setup did not say which file was involved; naming the path makes misplaced config or data_dir problems easier to spot.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Cap cached dial addresses at the 8 most recently seen per machine and refuse undialable ones.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Eviction drops the least recently seen address, and unspecified or port-0 addresses are refused, which bounds both memory and reconnect cost.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Return fan_out in the group send response and warn and count when it is zero.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: 200 still means the local write succeeded, but fan_out shows how many peers were published to; 0 increments gossip_publish_zero_fanout and logs a warning.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Send public group messages over gossip and unicast at the same time instead of one after the other.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Racing both paths means a failed unicast no longer delays delivery until the gossip fallback.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Salt the MLS epoch history msg_id with the group stable_id
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Identical messages in two groups at the same epoch got the same msg_id and the second was dropped as Duplicate. A new hash domain including stable_id makes ids unique per group.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pass the envelope-verified writer into TaskList merge_delta and authorize on it.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An earlier attempt compared the payload PeerId, which is just a set tag not an identity, and accepted unsigned deltas; using the verified envelope writer blocks forged deltas.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the Encrypted KvStore policy impossible to construct and fail closed until it is implemented.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Blocking the policy prevents anyone relying on encryption that is not there; the real encrypted store is left for later.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add NetworkNode::peer_admission and route all dials and gossip send/recv through it
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Code checked raw is_connected, so suppressed peers could come back. One admission state (Admitted, Suppressed, PlanePending, NotConnected) checked by every dial path keeps suppressed peers down.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make self-update restart transactional so an unsupervised daemon does not stay down
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With stop_on_upgrade = true the daemon called exit(0) expecting a supervisor to restart it; a terminal-launched daemon with none stayed down. The handoff now confirms the new binary is running.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Treat a sole member leaving as deleting the group, skipping the last-admin precheck.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: last_admin_self_leave_precheck_error checked the roster after removal, which is empty for a sole member, so it always returned 409.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-check peer suppression right before emitting PeerConnected on inbound accepts
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Suppression was checked at accept(), then bootstrap-cache bookkeeping was awaited, so a PolicyRejected peer could still produce a PeerConnected event. Closing that gap keeps suppressed peers silent.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Reject NonMemberRequest on live-to-withdrawn commits in validate_live_to_withdrawn_authority
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A sole-member carve-out returned Ok without checking the action kind, so a Pending sole signer could withdraw a group as a non-member. The check now applies to that case.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give x0xd-443 its own identity_dir and warn on ignored config keys.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A separate identity directory gives the second daemon its own ids, so DMs reach the right instance.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Update e2e_full_audit.sh to the current API contract and record HTTP status correctly.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Helpers now capture status and body (a status set in a subshell was lost), so 4xx errors show the daemon's message; version checks use the binary under test and GUI probes authenticate.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Upgrade to saorsa-gossip 0.5.72 so not-connected peers are evicted instead of cooled
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Keeping disconnected peers on cooldown left them in the peer set and contributed to a gossip storm; evicting them removes them cleanly.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Upgrade to saorsa-gossip 0.5.73 so outbound budget exhaustion no longer puts peers on cooldown
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Running out of local send budget is local saturation, not a peer fault; cooling healthy peers for it fed a message storm.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Never block the receive pump, and lower the uni-stream budget from 4,096 to 256
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A blocked receive pump stalls all inbound traffic. Keeping it non-blocking and allowing fewer concurrent unidirectional streams reduces memory and backpressure problems.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a Leaf participation mode for desktop daemons in gossip.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Desktop daemons take a lighter demand-driven role in the gossip mesh instead of acting as full relays.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Hedge the durable ACK on first success and pre-warm the Direct reverse path
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Cuts 504s at budget_stage=ack_wait_ms, where publish returned but the app ACK missed its budget, without moving durable sends to raw QUIC or raising timeouts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make leaf nodes refuse GRAFT and eager push on topics they are not subscribed to
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Leaf nodes were being pulled into relaying traffic for topics they do not use; refusing it is a required step toward fixing durable message timeouts but not enough alone.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Dial by PeerId wherever a PeerId is known instead of by address only
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Address-only dials skip ant-quic's HolePunching and Relay stages by design. Using the PeerId unlocks those stages, so NATed peers stop endlessly re-dialling remote private addresses.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop re-broadcasting machine and user announcements and reject cache upserts with stale announced_at
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Re-broadcast was not needed, and echoed old announcements could bring back entries already removed. A freshness check on the signed announced_at stops that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Only advertise relay or coordinator roles when the node looks publicly reachable
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Nodes advertised helper capabilities they could not serve. Requiring plausibly public reachability stops over-advertising on the x0x side.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Hedge the durable ACK over a direct typed path after durable commit
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Sending the ACK over a direct path as well as gossip reduces remaining durable send 504s at budget_stage=ack_wait_ms; it does not fully fix them alone.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let leaf-mode receivers always send the durable ACK back
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: On v0.39.8, durable messages arrived and committed but the leaf receiver's ACK publish failed on every route (ack_publish_route_failed), so senders got a 504 at budget_stage: ack_wait_ms.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Unwrap the V2 gossip envelope with decode_v2 before storm-control validators read announcements
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: In v0.40.1 validators got the signed V2 envelope but expected bare announcements, so extraction failed and the fail-open rule forwarded everything; counters were 0 everywhere. Bare input still works as fallback.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Probe the exact bind address in addr_is_free instead of loopback for unspecified binds
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: addr_is_free_probes_loopback_for_unspecified_bind failed every time on macOS while passing on Linux, because the probe checked a different address than the one actually bound.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Address security and code quality review comments.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Follow-up changes from code review; the text gives no further detail.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bind RelayHeader to its inner DmEnvelope payload, negotiated by capability
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A relay could pair a valid header with a different valid envelope, so relay-hop contact gating and accounting blamed the wrong sender. Binding them fixes attribution; end-to-end auth was already covered by the inner signature.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Lock argument-level parity between the CLI and the Home Suite API in tests/parity_cli.rs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The old test only proved a CLI path existed per endpoint. Now every request field a daemon handler accepts must be exposed by the CLI or listed with a reason why not.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require a durable owner on owner-only handlers and return a typed 403 otherwise.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Each handler checks ActorContext is_durable_owner(), the same pattern already used elsewhere, so session tokens are refused.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make Home state safe for older versions to load, and keep tests out of the real ~/.x0x.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Older binaries can start on newer Home state without crashing, and tests use their own paths instead of the developer's default dir.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make capability adverts and agent cards backward compatible with v0.40.4 peers.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Old peers misparsed the new positional field and re-encoded card signable bytes differently, failing verification; the encoding is now compatible both ways.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix a cluster of certified-membership bugs found in Home Suite test campaigns
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Fixes four related membership issues together, each with its own root cause and regression test.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Roll back only the keys a failed mutation changed, using compare-and-restore.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Before and after copies are taken under the same lock; each key is restored only if unchanged since, so other groups' writes survive.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix CLI EPIPE handling, e2e VPS harness gates and v0.41.0 doc gaps
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Three hygiene findings in one commit: the CLI handles a closed output pipe (EPIPE), the end-to-end VPS harness gets proper gates, and missing docs are filled.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix several Home and transport bugs: self-leave revision gap, seal order, restart self-dial, early marker.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The owner applies device self-leaves, Home seal no longer needs the owner announce first, restarted daemons stop dialling themselves, and the Home marker waits for a durable join.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Send authenticated, attempt-bound join refusals and finalize pending joins
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Join refusals are now tied to the specific join attempt and authenticated, so a joiner can trust them, and pending joins get finished cleanly; further hardening was deferred.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin tinyvec below 1.13 because 1.13.0 fails to build on rustc 1.95.0
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: tinyvec 1.13.0 fails with cannot find macro vec in this scope. Since Cargo.lock is not committed, every CI job picked it up fresh through ant-quic and went red.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Raise the require-green-CI poll limit from 20 to 45 minutes.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The coverage job now runs longer than 20 minutes, so the gate needs to wait long enough for it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Set X0X_SUPERVISED=1 in the launchd autostart plist
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A stopgap so a daemon started by launchd on macOS knows it is supervised and will be restarted.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix a self-update bug and a batch of flaky tests found after the v0.41.1 release
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The full suite failed on a different test each run while each passed alone. Root-causing the four flaky groups turned up a real production bug in the self-update path, fixed with a version-proven handoff.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Disable mDNS in the hermetic test fixture and narrow the changelog's mdns claim
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Closes two minor review findings after a batch merge: the fixture no longer does mDNS discovery, and the changelog no longer overstates what the mdns setting does.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Do not block the install script on read prompts when piped with no GPG.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With curl | sh there is no TTY, so read got no input, defaulted to No and the script exited silently without installing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix an unclosed listener call that left the embedded GUI blank in v0.41.1 and v0.41.2
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A syntax error in the GUI script stopped it from running, so the page rendered blank with one console error and no network requests. v0.41.3 fixes the call and adds a parse check.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Elect one deterministic canonical Home across an owner's devices and ignore pointers to withdrawn Homes
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Devices with different Homes kept overwriting the shared pointer, and a stale pointer to a withdrawn Home blocked replacement. A pointer is ignored only when local state proves that Home is withdrawn.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Filter Hidden groups out of every GET /groups/discover source after withdrawal
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Clearing the cached card was not enough because the endpoint rebuilt a card from retained group state. Hidden cards are now filtered from all merge sources and the local fallback, and refused on cache refresh.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make an ACP harness wait for a real discovered machine ID before minting placement
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Without a discovered machine it could pin itself to the owner daemon's machine. It now waits for a nonzero ID and never falls back to the owner machine; pairing still applies.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Put test node identities inside each disposable node data directory via identity_dir
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Convergence test nodes omitted identity_dir, so a peer stored or reused identities in the operator's real home directory. Configs now keep identities in disposable storage across reconnects.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop pruning keys after a stale checkpoint that merge_delta rejected
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The sync listener treated merge_delta's success return as permission to prune, even when the stale checkpoint was silently rejected, so newer values disappeared and could not be replayed back.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Sync the published agent card version with the package and validate agent.json at release
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The card still said 0.10.0 because version bumps only covered Cargo.toml and SKILL.md. The card is now part of the version rule and release packaging checks the copied agent.json.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Expose the participation snapshot with corrected relay counters on GET /diagnostics/gossip
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The endpoint left out the participation data needed for soak checks. It now shows resolved mode and reason plus non-subscribed relay counters, instead of the older meter that also counted subscribed forwarding.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Require proof the agent was in the owner roster before accepting a pending placement as PASS.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An absent ledger row alone proved nothing, so the test now needs a successful owner-roster capture for the same agent first.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Propose recovery of the ordinary Home persistence file pair.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: This is a design proposal for handling a split between the sidecar and named_groups.json after a failed save.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Re-read file-backed API tokens after rotation so REST and SSE clients recover from 401
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test runner kept its startup token after the file was replaced, so REST requests and SSE reconnects stayed stuck on 401. Reloading the credential lets them recover.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Isolate CI test networking and fixtures, and use ant-quic 0.27.50 for the explicit-bind fix
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Adds a CI isolation fence for runtime networking and pulls the explicit bind address fix from the crates.io ant-quic 0.27.50 release instead of a git pin.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stabilise merged task order and move timing checks out of the correctness test.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Tasks outside the winning ordering were appended in hash-set order and could vary; they now go in stable TaskId order, and timing is checked separately.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep an index of canonical group messages keyed by history.msg_id for direct lookups
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: GET /history/message/:msg_id?scope=group:<id> used a 4096-row scan, so old messages could not be found as history grew. The index is updated on write and backfilled at startup.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a read-only duplicate Home inventory and owner-driven seating via POST /home/seat.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Owners can see duplicate Homes and choose where a device sits; this is a partial fix with no automatic adoption.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Remove the invalid --all-features flag from the llvm-cov report step
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The flag is not valid for the report command and broke the Coverage Gate workflow.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Install SignaturePolicy::RejectV1 by default in PubSubManager and fail closed if it does not apply
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Every constructor now rejects old v1 outer signatures, returning NetworkError::NodeCreation if the policy fails to stick. GET /diagnostics/gossip shows outer_signature_policy and outer_v1_receipts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Tighten policy-admission grants, share one OVERALL predicate, and reap probes
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Follow-up to modern policy admission that fixes three review findings: grants are strict, one shared predicate decides the overall result, and leftover probes are cleaned up.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Expose legacy_grants_enabled: false on GET /diagnostics/gossip
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The flag sits next to outer_signature_policy: reject_v1 so testers can confirm grants are disabled; no grant or AcceptV1 API exists, and a test asserts the value.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the reliable voice-call demo fail at its 10 s connection deadline instead of carrying on
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The demo went on to signaling even if the transport connection never appeared. It now returns a clear failure at the absolute deadline, and a predicate that turns true exactly at the deadline is rejected.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Show discovered agents by contact label, then advertised self_name, then ID
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Agents appeared as truncated IDs even when they had a name. The new order applies to the dashboard, contact list and agent detail, keeps the ID visible, and HTML-escapes both names.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report which transport actually delivered the durable ACK, separately from the chosen send strategy
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The receipt hardcoded path: gossip_inbox even when the ACK came back over the direct typed or raw-QUIC path. The response now shows the observed ingress path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add GET /history/scopes and allow GET /history/search without a scope.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Owners can list scopes with row counts and newest timestamps and search across all of them with keyset pagination; these discovery routes are owner-only.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Contain private space page stores in the GUI and keep failed edits instead of discarding them
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Interim GUI-only containment: private spaces' page stores are blocked and an edit that fails to save is preserved, with no backend or Rust change.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Reapply revocation, expiry and placement checks to the authenticated ForwardV2 header opener
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A moved-away agent's old key could still pass the separate attestation and ACL gate and reach the target. Checking current authority on the exact opener blocks it while the live agent still works.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check membership, pick the key, sign and seal encrypted KV sync under one GSS read lock
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Doing these steps separately let a member removed in between still publish. One lock closes the race, and receivers accept only Delta and FullState on the encrypted main topic.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep Wiki and Web page stores blocked until all pending privacy policy updates settle
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A late GET of the old public policy could allow a page write after the backend had already made the space private. A per-space pending count, then a fresh policy read, closes that window.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a legacy DM inbox opt-out and authenticate A2A responses (integration branch)
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Integration update carrying the legacy-bus inbox opt-out and authenticated A2A response correlation, kept open so a combined branch can merge it after fresh CI.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Correlate A2A responses to requests in an authenticated way
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Responses are matched to their requests using authenticated data, so a reply cannot be attributed to the wrong request.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Reject unauthorized causal-transition queue entries before they use queue capacity or trigger catch-up
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Unauthorized entries could fill the bounded queue and cause fanout. Authorized members still get missing-predecessor recovery, and replay drops entries that became unauthorized. Also bundles authenticated A2A response matching and legacy inbox opt-out.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Validate existing GSS encrypted group store bindings before reuse, and register port-0 forwards at the real bound port
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Stores could be reused under the wrong identity or authority. Bindings are now checked against group identity, app name, creator, membership and policy, invalid ones are retired, and a port 0 forward records its actual address instead of :0.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Match announce-blob responses to the digest that was requested before verifying them
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Concurrent fetches share one response topic, so a fetch for digest A could take B's response, fail verification and give up before A's answer came. Filtering by digest avoids that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop the announce-blob responder loop once both request inputs have closed
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A closed carrier kept returning an immediately ready None, starving the live carrier, and with both closed the loop never ended. Exiting when both are closed and drained fixes the busy loop.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run developer test and coverage recipes through the Linux isolation and binary-custody wrappers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Developer recipes previously ran outside the isolation boundary. Unsupported hosts, root execution and missing prerequisites are now refused before anything runs; test selections are unchanged.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Route tests/run_full_suite.sh nextest and doctest runs through the isolation launcher
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The script ran tests directly on the host, bypassing isolation. Now doctests run inside the Linux supervisor, and unsupported hosts or missing prerequisites fail before compiling, with no host fallback.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fix the Panic Scanner regex so it really detects production .expect(...) calls
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A malformed regex was silently treated as no matches, so the scanner passed everything. The corrected pattern works in both scanner paths, and control tests now check the scanner before the real scan runs.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Correct the gossip diagnostics text to name the published egress ceiling API
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The status wrongly described the dependency as an unpublished draft. It now names the published API while still flagging the experimental sustained-cap and field-acceptance limits.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pass the --locked flag only once in the isolated nextest wrapper.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Passing --locked twice made cargo nextest list exit before any test ran.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give the gossip dispatch benchmark an isolated loopback network with no bootstrap, mDNS or port mapping
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The benchmark used production transport defaults, so unrelated discovery and bootstrap traffic skewed measurements. Explicit loopback bind and disabled discovery match the test fixtures.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Build the live test daemon's config from the selected network instead of production defaults
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The live-network test defaults to testnet, but its local daemon inherited production bootstrap seeds. The config is now generated and validated for the chosen network before launch.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Have the capability advert service own and stop its announce-blob responder task
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Repeated starts threw away each responder handle, so after Agent shutdown those tasks kept waiting and held cache and PubSub references. Owning the handle lets shutdown stop them.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the hs_f2 restart barrier wait for real gossip readiness, and log owner peer-table loss
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Test-only change: the barrier now asserts on existing NetworkNode surfaces such as connected_peers, gossip_plane_peers and peer_admission instead of assuming readiness, and adds diagnostics for the lost peer table.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Decouple /health from transport locks, make logging non-blocking, and fix a negative drop counter
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: x0xd 0.41.3 on mainnet aborted itself 5 to 12 times an hour, leaving clients with connection-refused gaps. Stopping /health from waiting on transport locks and logs from blocking removes the trip mechanism.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add an mdns config knob and make test daemons hermetic by default.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With mDNS discovery off for tests, test daemons stay out of the production mesh.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give the controlled-load test deadline real headroom so it stops timing out under CI load
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The test had two separate failure modes; this widens the deadline for the first one only and does not claim the flake is fully gone.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Decide who owns the restart before replacing the binary, and refuse conflicting managed config.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Checking ownership up front stops the daemon from spawning its own detached copy while a supervisor like a Windows Service or launchd also relaunches it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check that a connection is still current before opening a reliable-lane stream on it
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Streams opened on a connection that had already been replaced silently lost voice frames. Guarding the open against superseded connections fixes the loss seen in connection_churn_falls_back_to_reliable.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the home_suite_groups.json sidecar and named_groups.json recoverable together as one unit
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: save_named_groups_checked_unlocked writes the authoritative sidecar first, then named_groups.json. Treating both as one recoverable unit means a failure between the two writes can be repaired instead of leaving them out of step.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Raise the phase-barrier budget in asymmetric_capability_convergence_tests.rs from 3 s to 15 s
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The 3 s barrier was too short on busy CI machines. The panic message now reports the real budget and elapsed wait; no assertions or barrier conditions changed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Recalibrate test convergence barriers to match measured contention, not a guessed budget
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The deadline-based test kept timing out under load; the new budgets follow what CI measurements actually showed, after CI disproved part of the first calibration guess.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Include agent.json in the release version-sync gate.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The gate now fails a release if agent.json does not match the version.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Give every daemon-spawning test its own fixture-owned identity directory and fix the profile test's response shape
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The 'real' name was actually the test's hard-coded value; the test failed because ApiResponse flattens its data so r["data"][x] was null. Isolated identities and correct parsing remove both problems.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin the Rust toolchain to 1.95.0 and box RejectedReadiness so clippy 1.98 is also clean
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Boxing the large type first satisfies the newer clippy lint, then the pin makes every machine run the same toolchain so lint results match CI.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add an explicit single-instance lock on the data directory
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With history disabled, two daemons could run on one data dir and identity, both healthy; with it enabled they only failed at SQLite with database is locked and no clear owner.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Bind Space Channels to group stores and report failed saves
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Saves could fail without the user knowing, and channels were not tied to their group store.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add tests pinning that a zero-member group is unreachable on current main.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The race no longer produces a reachable group, so tests characterize it and keep it from coming back.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Classify alternate chains from fork evidence and complete owner-anchored clears.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Group members can recognise a fork from a removed admin as an alternate chain instead of adopting it; applies to owner-axis groups only.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Persist task-list content to disk with TaskListStorage and reload it on restart
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Before, TaskListStorage had no production callers, so content existed only in the in-memory replica. Saving it locally means a restarted daemon can rehydrate the list without a live peer.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop advertising undialable interface addresses in the agent card when the listener is bound to loopback
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A loopback-bound daemon was publishing interface hints peers could not reach, so connects timed out; suppressing those hints leaves only dialable addresses.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the local shell e2e suites hermetic and fix their stale assertions
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The suites depended on host state and checked outdated behaviour, so they failed or passed unreliably.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Gate bootstrap full-serve pruning by the content policy and clean up the related leftovers
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Applying the content_allowed check on prune makes it follow the same policy as serving, and removes the dead annotations flagged in review.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Advertise only the explicitly bound P2P address in gossip identity adverts
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Since ant-quic 0.27.50 honours a specific bind_address, adverts listing every host interface pointed peers at addresses that no longer accept connections.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Hold the instance lock while draining, map Unix open failures, and guard the shared identity_dir
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Fixes gaps in the single-instance guard so two daemons cannot overlap during shutdown or share an identity directory.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Enforce the SIGTERM exit deadline with a watchdog on a plain OS thread.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Graceful shutdown worked, but the backstop watchdog could not fire or exit when teardown misbehaved; an OS-thread watchdog guarantees the 5 s bounded exit.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let only the blob owner answer announce blob requests and coalesce requests per digest
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Every cache holder answered every miss, so announce/v3/blob ran at about 825 KB/s instead of a tiny steady rate, and each reply was verified by every peer.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Answer targeted capability requests only on the response topic
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Each targeted request also republished the full advert fleet-wide, so the 600 s advert ran at the request rate.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Remove the extra ML-DSA verify from track_iwant in src/gossip/egress.rs
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It verified every inbound IWANT frame only to update diagnostic counters, duplicating the verify PlumTree already does.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Harden test fixtures with retries for setup dials and larger probe budgets under load.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both flakes come from CPU starvation in the test environment, not product bugs, so only the fixtures were changed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Republish the steady capability advert on a timer in on-demand mode
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Consumers drop cached adverts after 900 s (ADVERT_CACHE_TTL_SECS), so without regular republishes strict sends failed with AckSemanticsUnavailable, an HTTP 409.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Guard reconnect Phase 2 against recovery happening mid-attempt and settle hs_f2 restarts deterministically
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The reconnect logic no longer acts on stale state if the connection recovers during an attempt, and the restart test waits for a settled state rather than timing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the hs_f2 restart settle barrier close the stale owner connection on timeout instead of panicking.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: ant-quic can leave an old connection alive after shutdown (closed only by Drop), so forcing a disconnect works around that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a bounded retry to the announce-blob fetch in the hs_f2 restart test
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The product normally retries on its next heartbeat, but the test has no short heartbeat, so a bounded retry mirrors that recovery.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run launchd readback subprocesses with spawn_blocking and record which launchd domain matched
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Moving plutil and launchctl calls off the async threads keeps the runtime responsive during upgrades.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Build lib tests on Windows in CI, await the history reaper, and make the drain test deterministic
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Awaiting the reaper closes the window where two exclusive SQLite handles overlap, and replacing timing with deterministic sync removes flakiness.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Remove the hs_f2 settle-barrier workaround now that ant-quic 0.27.52 fixes the cause
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: With the upstream bug fixed the test passed 60/60 in debug without the workaround.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the Python legacy-bus derivation count eager plus IHAVE, matching the Rust oracle
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Both checks now use the same definition of bus egress, so pure-IHAVE runs pass in both.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the fleet health checker check every host and compare against the current version
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Post-increment arithmetic returned status 1 under set -e, so it stopped after the first healthy host, and it compared against the old v0.14.0.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Run coverage with --no-fail-fast and record each phase's exit code so reporting still runs after test failures
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The shell no longer stops at the first failed test, so LCOV generation and threshold checks still happen, while any failed phase still fails the job.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Evict relay topic validators and token buckets after one hour of inactivity
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Idle state is dropped while base and locally subscribed topics are kept; install, use, eviction and clear share one lifecycle lock so a topic seen again cannot be cleared after reinstall.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Upgrade to saorsa-webrtc 0.6 and keep SessionConflict typed through LinkTransport.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Callers can now tell a refused concurrent session apart from a real I/O failure.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Suppress replayed commands by sender, request id and command fingerprint, and keep completed results
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Lost delivery acks caused commands to run twice; coalescing duplicates and returning stored outcomes avoids rerunning actions.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make PubSubManager::subscribe wait until the subscription is registered before returning
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Without the wait, a publish made right after subscribing could be missed by the new subscriber.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Check the rendered systemd or launchd policy and live readback before reporting a supervised restart
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Restart checks could claim success too early; definitions now reject control characters and output collection cleans up child processes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Validate the release ref and metadata before starting any platform builds
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A manual Release dispatch from a branch ran all builds and only failed later when the branch name was used as a version.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Read systemd ExecStart arguments through busctl JSON when verifying a restart
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: systemctl's text output loses argument boundaries for paths with spaces, percent signs or dollars, so readback was wrong.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Build the signing test packages with optimisation and run the 100k-message test in its own CI job
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The slow-subscriber test exceeded its 600-second deadline because signing ran unoptimised; the job also checks exact delivery counts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Force a private HOME and X0X_HOME on tmpfs in the isolated runtime again
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Passing the host HOME through (ENV_KEYS, sudo --preserve-env=HOME) broke the isolation that keeps test runs from sharing state.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Poll until the roster converges before asserting self-membership in the e2e test
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The script checked membership right after POST /groups/join, before the change had propagated, causing flaky failures.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin saorsa-gossip to exactly =0.5.82
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: 0.5.83 added fields to FanoutCounts, breaking struct literals; with caret requirements and no committed Cargo.lock, every fresh CI build picked it up and failed to compile.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Use one shared fork-quarantine group resolver and let the manual clear route accept the stable group id
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Different code paths resolved group ids differently, so the manual clear could miss a group referenced by its other spelling.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make fork_quarantine fault-injection hooks per-instance instead of global
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Global hooks were shared between tests running in parallel under cargo test, so one test's fault could hit another; per-instance hooks keep them isolated.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Resolve alias-keyed groups when persisting TreeKEM snapshots so no generation is burned
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Groups stored under an alias key were not found at snapshot time, wasting a key generation.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep fork quarantine in place across journal recovery, sidecar merges and group id aliases
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Different records for the same group could disagree on quarantine, and importing a valid card could create a clean alias that cleared it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Install the quarantine gate before sync starts and reliably re-authorise and drain buffered deltas
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Sync could process deltas before the quarantine check was in place, and buffered deltas were not always re-checked or delivered.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop KvStoreSync from merging or persisting anything after retire
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Checking retirement before applying a delta prevents writes to a store that has been shut down.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep full build diagnostics, hide API tokens, and avoid changing host-wide log policy in the testnet deploy script
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The script cut off failure output, printed an API-token prefix, and always altered global logging when deploying the parallel testnet.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fence snapshot reopen and persistence so a reopen waits for the retired sync to finish
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A retire, drain, then reopen order stops two writers touching the same snapshot path.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Resume durable task ingest and fence off retired listeners
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Old listeners could keep handling events after being replaced, and task ingest could stop; fencing and resuming keeps one active consumer.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the voice E2E test fail on unmet network prerequisites and pace frames with a 20 ms timer.
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It could pass without building agents when UDP binding was denied, continued past the connection deadline, and burst all 250 frames; it now asserts a two-way connection first and matches the demo's pacing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Install the testnet runner under its canonical name, testnet
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The deploy selector passed a different name than the installer accepted, so the systemd ExecStart pointed at a runner that was never installed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the testnet runner retry incomplete subscriptions with bounded backoff
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: When a DELETE fails ambiguously it keeps the old subscription id until removal is confirmed, and a 404 is treated as stale so a replacement can be made.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Merge the v0.46.0 candidate transport and group fixes into main without tagging a release
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Lands the frozen candidate for fleet acceptance testing; the version stays 0.45.0 until a later release gate.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep Leaf peers beyond the eager degree as lazy topic members
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Peers that do not fit the eager set still receive IHAVE announcements, so they can fetch messages instead of being cut off.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Limit the lazy-retention change to Leaf nodes and restore Full-node peer behaviour
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The change was meant for Leaf nodes but also altered Full nodes; scoping it brings Full nodes back to their earlier peer selection.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop treating an unsigned invite-base stub as fork evidence
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A joiner on a stale invite was marked fork-quarantined because of an unsigned stub, so every store open returned 409 group is unavailable.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Refuse to mint a seat invite into a non-canonical duplicate Home group
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Inviting into a duplicate group puts members in the wrong place; this blocks the unsafe case while the root cause awaits a design decision.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Stop a lost Welcome Offer ACK from aborting the TreeKEM Welcome transfer
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The joiner already knows the chunk count and hash from the signed WelcomeRef, so the Offer is only advisory and losing its ACK should not cancel the stream.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Never proactively shed Critical-topic control frames in the receive pump
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Classifying priority before the over-90% shed keeps IHAVE/IWANT repair for critical topics, matching the sender-side protection.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep the joiner waiting for the Welcome after a FetchRequest receipt timeout
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The owner can send a valid Welcome before the delivery receipt arrives; the joiner used to give up on the receipt timeout and throw away those bytes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Carry the joiner's AgentCertificate in MemberJoined so the owner can verify it inline
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The owner could not verify the joiner without fetching the certificate separately, which blocked Home group joins end to end.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a POST /agent/sign endpoint that returns detached ML-DSA-65 signatures
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: It signs the exact bytes given with the agent key and returns a versioned scheme id x0x.agent-sign.v1.ml-dsa-65; callers handle canonicalisation and domain separation.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Adopt no TreeKEM catch-up commits unless the chain reaches the pending owner-attested head
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Validating the whole chain before applying anything stops a forking responder's intermediate commits from being accepted.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Retry cold encrypted-store sync and classify why a request was rejected
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A store opened before its joiner was authorised stopped requesting forever when sealing a StateRequest returned None, and cold sync was slow or missing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Only let a session token read a named group's details when it is an active member of that group
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A token for one group could read another group's roster and invite history through GET /groups/:id and the /members route.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Document that /ws WebSocket messages have no stable ID and may be duplicated or dropped
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Relay, replay and reconnect can duplicate notifications and the bounded queue may skip frames, so clients must not treat the live stream as complete or exactly-once.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Let revoke_binding find the daemon's own certificate from agent.cert
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Agent::agent_certificate_for only checked the peer cache and the lean issuance journal; using the durable agent.cert copy for self lets revocation succeed.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Apply the membership gate to delegation reads and quarantine annotations
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Delegation data now uses the same check as the group read, so non-members cannot see it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make the control-blob cap count only in-flight blobs, and park late role updates instead of dropping them
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Blobs no longer hold slots until TTL expiry, and role updates that arrive early wait until they can apply.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Publish the local Home pointer before every owner-sync session
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Peers then always learn an existing Home during sync, so the creator does not think none exists.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Un-wedge the retained-image pool so plain members can serve history, and name the store in refusals
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The pool of retained store images had got stuck, blocking members from serving joiners; refusals now say which store they refer to.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Prefer connected, authenticated roster members as eager gossip peers for group topics
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Nodes picked eager peers from any connection, so a real group member could end up on the slow lazy path while non-member relays got the pushes.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Keep predecessor retries working and deliver ordinary DMs that happen to start with a typed prefix
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A full typed channel could drop a payload after reporting success, and a normal DM whose bytes began with a registered prefix was swallowed by a handler that rejected it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Encrypt group task-list deltas with the group key
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Group task lists were only protected by a REST membership check and a writer allow-list; the deltas went over the wire in plaintext.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Report SelfKeyed quota evictions in the put response and store events
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Writers now see which of their keys were evicted instead of losing them silently.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Never let unattested gossip DM claims rebind a sender's routing
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: InboxPipeline::handle_incoming fell back to the sender-claimed sender_machine_id, which the agent signature does not prove, so a peer could redirect another agent's routing.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a non-interactive Windows installer that installs the binaries
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Gives Windows users a scripted install that actually places the binaries, without prompts.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Pin the real release-signing fingerprint in install.py and add a CI check against drift
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Signature checks now match the actual signing key, and CI catches future mismatches.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Fetch missing certificates for digest-only roster seats at seal time
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: An admin refused every MemberJoined because some seats had only certificate digests not in any local cache, so the joiner retried forever; fetching them unblocks the join.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Verify the release tarball checksum and signature in install.sh before installing
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The install script installed whatever it downloaded; checking checksum and signature first stops tampered or corrupt releases.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Shut down both writers in bridge() so EOF becomes a QUIC FIN, and finish denial replies
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: tokio::io::copy never calls poll_shutdown, so SendStream::finish was not reached and ant-quic reset the unfinished stream on drop (code 0xA17C0244), breaking half-close and read_to_end.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Include owner-device certificates in membership events
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Roster seats held only certificate digests and the certificate bytes came only from the owner's announce every 600 s, so others often could not verify members in time.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Serialize encrypted group KV publishing with roster commits
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A publisher could refresh at epoch E, pause while a member removal committed E+1, then still seal under E, letting the removed member read it.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Publish encrypted task lists only under the current group epoch
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: Publishing under an old epoch could seal data with a key that removed members still hold; checking the epoch first prevents that.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Admit ShareGrant Call holders in call_gate_inbound
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The grant check is added at the reserved hook so it only overrides the trust check, not revocation or ACL.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Add a durable owner-side redelivery outbox for ShareGrant deliveries
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: The owner stores pending grants on disk and resends them, so missed deliveries are retried.

https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.fix: Make a revoke that happens during POST's initial DM stick so it cannot be undone
https://github.com/saorsa-labs/x0x/pull/.how: A revocation that arrived while the first DM was in flight could be overwritten later, effectively restoring revoked access.
